summary: Hardened Codex queue result ingestion report persistence and post-batch review traceability. Result ingestion reports now use task-slug, high-resolution timestamp, and UUID-suffixed stable filenames. Post-batch review now writes a batch review ledger with per-task execution, result, ingestion, and review evidence paths. Latest reports remain convenience pointers and are no longer used as authoritative ingestion allowance evidence.

stable_reports: per-task execution reports linked from batch reports

known_issues_resolved: Result ingestion report filenames no longer use only second-level timestamps.
Rapid repeated ingestion calls persist unique stable report paths.
Post-batch task rows record direct stable ingestion report paths.
Batch postprocess writes a batch-wide review ledger with per-task evidence paths.
latest_result_ingestion_report.json is surfaced as pointer metadata instead of ingestion allowance evidence.
known_issues_remaining: Generated operational reports may still contain absolute local paths; the retention policy treats them as local evidence and warns against blind publication.
A full saved-evidence replay command is documented as the next step rather than implemented in this task.
Queue done still means automation-task completion, not PMBOT product artifact approval.
